description: Run before setting a priority fee. Gives the price in the unit Compute Budget expects (micro-lamports per compute unit) and the total in SOL, so a unit mix-up never overpays. Turns recent priority fees into three prices: cheap, normal, fast. Pass your transaction to get its compute limit and exact cost at each. Example: {} for network prices, or {"tx": "<base64>"} for your own. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/fee.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

tx.description: Your transaction, so fees match its accounts and compute comes from a dry run. Before signing: Buffer.from(tx.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false })).toString('base64'), or an aggregator's swap tx.
